title: Black holes
info: A black hole is a place where gravity is so strong that light cannot escape past a boundary called the event horizon.
Some form when a very massive star collapses at the end of its life.
A black hole does not suck up everything in the galaxy. Far away, its gravity feels like any other mass of the same size.
The huge black hole at the center of the Milky Way is called Sagittarius A*.
